name: WICeW October GoldFest '98

date.source: the card's own dated title, served at promotions/wicew/archive/results-1998-10-04.html

notes: The fed's own first pay-per-view. Crowned the first WICeW World Heavyweight, Cruiserweight, and United States Heavyweight Champions, and new North American Tag Team Champions; the European Title was left to be decided at an unheld Thursday Night House Show (Arch Angel vs. "Superstar" Steve Taylor, not captured in this holding).

matches.stipulation: North American Tag Team Championship
matches.note: The Hickerson Brothers w/Misha Tucker defeated the Killers in 17:28 to become the fed's own first North American Tag Team Champions.

matches.stipulation: World Tag Team Titles
matches.note: Billed as the Demon Knights defending against the Agents of War. Demon Knights retained the title despite losing the match by disqualification -- the broadcast states outright that a title does not change hands on a DQ or countout. The finish came via a Hickerson Brothers run-in defending Luther from the Deep Stryke, escalating into a six-man brawl (the Killers, Big Bad Buddha, Arch Angel, AC-10, and Exacutioner all entering the ring) before security separated everyone.

matches.stipulation: 10 Man, Over the Top Rope Battle Royal for the WICeW Cruiserweight Title
matches.note: 10 named entrants; only 7 clear the mint bar (see characters.json) -- "XXX Cameron McCarty," "Biohazzard," and "Mystikal" appear only in this one battle royal and are recorded as verbatim elimination labels. Gangsta New Jack won in 20:30 to become the fed's own first WICeW Cruiserweight Champion.

matches.stipulation: War Games
matches.note: A two-ring, steel-cage, six-man-per-team match (a coin toss determines which team sends reinforcements first, one new man from each side every two minutes, first pinfall or submission wins). The fed's own text never rosters either team by name -- Hell's Angels and Dominion of War are cross-referenced here from several textual clues: the broadcast calls the Hickerson Brothers Hell's Angels members outright after their opening match; Blizzard is named as leading Dominion of War with 'teammates' Scorpion and Thunder-Bolt; the match's own closing pairing sentence ('Denny and Thunder-Bolt, Angel and Blizzard, Blitzkrieg and Luther, Buddha and Exacutioner, Lucifer and Scorpion, and Luke and AC-10') sets six cross-team pairs; and the run-in grouping during the preceding tag match (the Killers backing Blitzkrieg/Blizzard, Big Bad Buddha and Arch Angel arriving together, AC-10 and Exacutioner arriving together) corroborates the split. Big Bad Buddha scored the winning fall on Exacutioner with two Buddha Slams, in a time of 28:43.

matches.stipulation: 30 Man, Over the Top Rope Battle Royal for the WICeW World Heavyweight Title
matches.note: 30 named entrants per the card's own heading; the broadcast's heavily templated, randomized commentary makes several apparent elimination beats ambiguous or self-contradictory (a handful of names recur in ordinary offense lines after their own formal elimination call, and one elimination call for Mad Man Max Marshall is credited to two different eliminators in two different sentences) -- only the unambiguous, cleanly-attributed eliminations are recorded above; "Zilla," "Marshall McCarty," "Sub-Zero," "Spectre," "Maj," "Michael '2 Sexy' Smith," "Judgement Night," "Loverboy," and "Solar" appear only in this one battle royal. Max A. Million won in 33:13 to become the fed's own first WICeW World Heavyweight Champion. Masta Gangsta, the final entrant eliminated, was named the fed's own first WICeW United States Heavyweight Champion as runner-up, per a stipulation announced during the broadcast.

name: WICeW Black November

date.source: the card's own dated title, served at promotions/wicew/archive/results-1998-11-08.html

notes: The fed's own second pay-per-view. The World Heavyweight and European Titles both changed hands; the Demon Knights' own final WICeW appearance; the No Limit Soldiers (TRU, DaLinkwent, Max A. Million) revealed as a stable; Sean "Iceman" Stevens turned on his own tag partner "Superstar" Steve Taylor.

matches.note: Duke "The Predator" Puzo defeated Dr. Doom in 12:42 -- Puzo's own first WICeW victory.

Silkk the Shocker w/Tanya defeated Poison w/Tower in 16:23; the broadcast frames Poison as returning from injury with some ring rust. Billed w/Tanya here -- Silkk's own bio card spells his valet's name Tonya; recorded as a spelling variant, not a separate identity.
The Old Rogues defeated the Killers in 15:42, a one-sided win.

Crush had the match under control off a piledriver setup when Chaos ran down and distracted him; referee Pat Nickerson ordered Chaos from ringside, and Hurricane rolled Crush up for the win in 19:11. Chaos never entered the match itself.

matches.stipulation: Cage Match
matches.note: "The Mercenary" Matt Gavin w/Amanda defeated Old Soldier in 15:28, a grudge match; the broadcast frames Old Soldier as fighting through an injured knee that finally gave out on a top-rope attempt.

matches.stipulation: Ladder Match for the WICeW World Television Title
matches.note: Gangsta New Jack w/Jacqueline retained in 13:38, knocking the ladder over to eliminate Scorpion mid-climb before grabbing the belt himself.

matches.stipulation: WICeW European Championship
matches.note: Volcano defeated champion Sean "Iceman" Stevens in 19:45 to become the new WICeW European Champion. The fed's own first-ever European Title match was billed for an uncaptured Thursday House Show after the 4 October 1998 card (Arch Angel vs. "Superstar" Steve Taylor) -- Stevens's own path to holding the belt by this date is not recorded (see titles.json's wicew-european notes).

matches.stipulation: Best 2 out of 3 Falls, 30-Minute Time Limit
matches.note: Billed by the card's own text as "the Cruiserweight Title match"; neither wrestler was the concurrently-held WICeW Cruiserweight Champion (Gangsta New Jack, per his own 4 October 1998 battle royal win, with no recorded loss before this date) -- recorded as billed, not reconciled. The two men split the first two falls (Barrows via a bridged German suplex, Blizzard via the Deep Freeze); the 30-minute time limit expired with the match tied, and referee Pat Nickerson ruled a draw.

matches.stipulation: WICeW Internet Title
matches.note: DaLinkwent retained against Jupiter w/Venus in 8:23. Afterward, TRU interrupted DaLinkwent's celebration wearing a WICeW U.S. Champion shirt over a shirt reading "No Limit Soldiers"; Max A. Million ran down to separate the two men, and the broadcast reveals TRU, DaLinkwent, and Max A. Million as the No Limit Soldiers, leaving together (see units.json's no-limit-soldiers-wicew).

matches.stipulation: Loser Leaves WICeW Match for the WICeW North American Tag Team Titles
matches.note: The Hickerson Brothers retained against the Demon Knights in 15:04 -- the Demon Knights' last appearance on file; the broadcast states they will have to wrestle in another federation from now on.

matches.stipulation: WICeW World Tag Team Titles
matches.note: Original Gangstaz retained against the Traditional Wrestling Order ("Superstar" Steve Taylor & Sean "Iceman" Stevens) in 18:04. Stevens turned on his own partner mid-match, striking Taylor in the head with a chair meant for Gangsta New Jack and rolling New Jack on top of Taylor for the pin. Stevens then took a microphone and cut a promo naming Taylor's traditionalist style pathetic, calling hardcore superior, and challenging Taylor to a loser-leaves-WICeW match the following Saturday, 21 November (not itself captured in this holding).

matches.stipulation: Texas Death Cage Match for the WICeW Extreme Championship
matches.note: Berserk defeated champion "Mad Man" Max Marshall in 13:49 to become the new WICeW Extreme Champion, busting Marshall open with a turnbuckle-padding-removed headshot before finishing with the Bloodrush and a ten count.

matches.stipulation: WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: TRU retained against Sabre in 15:24 -- primary-source corroboration that TRU held this title by this date, though how and when he won it from the title's first-attested holder, Masta Gangsta (4 October 1998), is not recorded (see titles.json's wicew-united-states notes).

matches.stipulation: WICeW World Heavyweight Title
matches.note: Main event. "Superstar" Steve Taylor defeated champion Max A. Million in 23:48 to become the new WICeW World Heavyweight Champion, closing out Black November.

name: WICeW Saturday Showdown, 5 December 1998

date.source: the card's own dated title, served at promotions/wicew/archive/results-1998-12-05.html

notes: The World Television and Extreme Titles both changed hands; the first-round WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament opened; Darkstar unmasked mid-match as the tournament's disguised entrant Eclipse; "The Colonel" Percy Miller joined the Mid South Syndicate; Johnny Hardcore announced his engagement.

matches.note: "Mad Man" Max Marshall defeated Cobra with the Decapitator in 6:43, a quick and violent win. The broadcast previews a triple-threat cage match signed between Marshall, Rage, and Berserk for the pay-per-view (not itself captured in this holding), and notes Dr. Doom "ended the career of Duke Roberts" the previous week -- an off-page event with no surviving card of its own, not otherwise structured here.

Suicide Kid defeated Kael w/Electra & $oulja in 23:19. $oulja attempted to have Kael Irish-whip Suicide Kid into a chair he was wielding at ringside; Suicide Kid reversed the whip, Kael narrowly avoided the chair himself, and Suicide Kid capitalized with the Suicide Kick for the pin.
Dr. Doom defeated Psycho Clown with the Doomsday in 7:24, a quick win.

TRU defeated Thunder-Bolt by disqualification in 16:15. Berserk ran in with a prop gravestone, striking TRU over the head with it and breaking it into pieces, then continued the beatdown with Thunder-Bolt joining in until security intervened -- setting up a Texas Death Cage Match between TRU and Berserk billed for that Monday.

Blitzkrieg defeated "The Colonel" Percy Miller in 18:46. Afterward, TRU came to ringside and jawed with Miller, then attacked him with the Fury DDT and a Sharpshooter before security intervened. Miller took a microphone and accepted an on-air offer to join the Mid South Syndicate, "the most dominant stable in the WICeW" (see units.json's mid-south-syndicate-wicew), and called TRU out for the following Saturday.

matches.stipulation: T.W.O. Induction Match
matches.note: Jon Northcross w/Dr. Thomas Alexander defeated Duke "The Predator" Puzo in 17:24, stipulated to send its winner into the Traditional Wrestling Order (T.W.O.). Jupiter interfered on Northcross's own behalf with his briefcase and the Black Hole while Dr. Thomas Alexander distracted referee Pat Nickerson, then crossed a name off a hit list inside the briefcase after the match.
Masta Gangsta defeated El Diablo w/MegaDeath with the Drive Bye in 6:26, a one-sided win as he readied for his own title match with "Superstar" Steve Taylor (not itself captured in this holding).

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Silkk the Shocker w/Tonya defeated "Dirty" Denny Hickerson with the DVD in 12:13.

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Crush defeated the masked "Eclipse" with the Cranium Crunch in 14:29 -- the finishing move tore off Eclipse's mask, revealing Darkstar underneath. The broadcast connects the reveal to WICeW President Gregory Joseph's own ban on N.L.S. members from this tournament (see characters.json's darkstar-wicew identity note and units.json's no-limit-soldiers-wicew).

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: "The Machine" Matt Gavin w/Amanda defeated Justice w/Liberty by disqualification in 16:53. $oulja ran in and attacked Gavin with a gut wrench powerbomb, a DDT, and the Bunghole Surprise before security separated the SoB from Gavin.

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Jupiter defeated Johnny Hardcore in 2:13 -- Jupiter offered a congratulatory handshake, then grabbed Johnny by the neck and hit the Black Hole for the pin. Earlier on the card, Johnny Hardcore announced his engagement to Amy, with the ceremony billed for a future WICeW Heartbreak Haven event (not itself captured in this holding).

matches.stipulation: WICeW World Television Title
matches.note: Red Dogg w/Cynthia defeated champion Gangsta New Jack to become the new WICeW World Television Champion in 12:43, rolling him up from behind while holding his tights. New Jack had kissed Cynthia mid-match over comments he and Masta Gangsta made about her, which the broadcast frames as her and Red Dogg's own payback.

matches.stipulation: WICeW Extreme Title, Texas Death Cage Match
matches.note: Down South Hustla defeated champion Berserk to become the new WICeW Extreme Champion in 12:43. TRU repeatedly tried to climb the cage during the match and was shaken off by Berserk; Hustla finished Berserk with back-to-back Hustla Hangovers and a ten count. TRU then made it into the cage as the broadcast cut off, with TRU and Berserk still fighting.

name: WICeW Monday Madness, 7 December 1998

date.source: the card's own dated title, served at promotions/wicew/archive/results-1998-12-07.html

notes: The Internet Title changed hands; the first-round WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament continued; "The Machine" Matt Gavin announced he had joined the Mid South Syndicate.

matches.stipulation: Texas Death Cage Match
matches.note: Berserk and TRU fought to a no contest when Thunder-Bolt gained control of the cage and raised it to the ceiling; the fight moved to the back, leaving a broken VCR and splintered baseball bats scattered in the ring.
Suicide Kid defeated Blood Killer with the Suicide Kick in 11:49; Blood Killer had opened the show by challenging Suicide Kid to the match.
Red Dogg defeated Nemesis by disqualification in 15:17 when Nemesis decked referee Pat Nickerson.

matches.stipulation: WICeW Internet Title
matches.note: Blizzard defeated champion DaLinkwent by pinfall in 23:48 to become the new WICeW Internet Champion. As DaLinkwent went for Capital Punishment, referee Pat Nickerson was inadvertently knocked out; Jupiter entered with his briefcase and hit DaLinkwent with the Black Hole twice, then left and revived the ref before Blizzard made the pin. Jupiter crossed another name off his hit list afterward.

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Sabre defeated Gangsta New Jack by pinfall in 18:21.

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Duke "The Predator" Puzo defeated Masta Gangsta by pinfall in 28:16.

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Dr. Doom defeated Down South Hustla by disqualification in 10:40. Berserk came to ringside and, rather than attacking Down South Hustla, nailed Dr. Doom with a forearm to the back of the head and stomped him, drawing the disqualification in Doom's favor; Doom and Berserk left together smiling as a furious Down South Hustla looked on.

matches.stipulation: 1st Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Blitzkrieg defeated Jon Northcross by pinfall in 19:55.

matches.stipulation: Mixed Tag Team Match
matches.note: $oulja & Dominique defeated "The Machine" Matt Gavin & Amanda in 22:10 when Dominique pinned Amanda with a hurricanrana. Earlier on the card, Gavin announced he had joined the Mid South Syndicate and, citing frustration with $oulja and Dominique, challenged them to this match.

name: WICeW Results, 10 December 1998

date.source: the card's own dated title, served at promotions/wicew/archive/results-1998-12-10.html

notes: Retroactively registered -- the original accession served this card (14 matches) but never gave it its own shows.json row, an oversight caught and closed while registering this wing's other results cards. A flash-results card: brief one-line results with two short prose asides (Rage/Berserk, Black Mafia).

matches.note: Gary Copley defeated Golem with the Figure Four Leg Lock in 9:48.

Rage defeated Detour with the Ultimate Rage in 15:40. Afterward, Berserk came out of the crowd and attacked Rage, tossing him into the steel steps and ring post before hitting the Blood Rush and leaving him on the arena floor.
Chaos defeated Stan Smith with the Death Valley Driver in 13:28.
Jupiter defeated Dom Valliere with the Black Hole in 8:21.
Gweedo the Wicked Klown defeated "Lucky" Luke Hickerson with the Big Top in 18:46.
Junior Skaggs defeated Dark Hart with the Frog Splash in 10:10.
Thunder-Bolt defeated Albert Eaton with the Thunder-Bolt Driver in 9:58.
"The Thriller" Brian Jackson defeated El Diablo with the Moon Walker in 14:22.
Justice defeated Albert Stanley with the Blindfold in 7:33.
Original Gangstaz defeated Nuclear Disaster when they executed the Harlem Hangover on Nuke in 13:19; only Nuke is individually named on the losing side.

Total Carnage defeated the Dangers of the Ocean when they executed the Guillotine on Tidal Wave in 17:13; only Tidal Wave is individually named on the losing side, and no individual is named for Total Carnage.
Dr. Doom defeated Volcano with the Doomsday Device in 14:31.

Black Mafia defeated Darkstar & Red Dogg as a result of a disqualification. The card's own prose names "Nemesis" as fighting Red Dogg mid-match and mentions "DS Hustla" being attacked, without cleanly resolving either name to a Black Mafia member or reconciling them with the billed two-man losing side; Darkstar produced a baseball bat from under the ring, struck Pat Nickerson with it (drawing the DQ), and beat down the Black Mafia's own side until security restored order. No membership is asserted for Black Mafia from this alone (see units.json's black-mafia-wicew).

The Shadow defeated Kyle Barrows as a result of a disqualification. Barrows was fighting back late in the match when Sabre ran in and attacked the Shadow, drawing the DQ; a three-way brawl followed until security intervened.

name: WICeW Saturday Showdown, 12 December 1998

date.source: the card's own dated title, served at promotions/wicew/archive/results-1998-12-12.html

notes: President Gregory Joseph stripped the Hickerson Brothers of the North American Tag Team Titles at the top of the show, promising the vacant title would be filled at the fed's next pay-per-view, and warned Jupiter over his in-match interference; the quarterfinals of the U.S. Heavyweight Title Tournament were held (the semifinals were set for a Thursday House Show, not itself captured in this holding). Original Gangstaz (Masta Gangsta & Gangsta New Jack) successfully defended the WICeW World Tag Team Titles by disqualification when Venus nailed Masta Gangsta with her loaded purse; Jacqueline then came to ringside and clashed with Venus before each tag team restrained its own manager. The challenging team is never named in the surviving text, so no matches[] row is structured for this defense -- Masta Gangsta and Gangsta New Jack are still credited an appearance below.

matches.note: Billed as Benjamins $quad defeating the Dangers of the Ocean in 15:17; the winning finisher, the Decapitator, is "Mad Man" Max Marshall's own bio-carded move, so he is recorded here at presumed grade as Benjamins $quad's own participant (see units.json's benjamins-squad-wicew).
Chris Champion defeated Stan Smith with the Champion Crossface in 8:21.
Suicide Kid defeated Gary Copley with the Suicide Kick in 8:41.
Johnny Hardcore defeated Hurricane with the All Canadian Driver in 25:44.
Berserk defeated Cobra with the Blood Rush in 9:13. The card's own results text repeats this exact result a second time verbatim later in the document; recorded once here as one match, not two.

matches.stipulation: WICeW World Television Title
matches.note: Red Dogg successfully defended against Junior Skaggs with the Million Dollar Dream in 12:29.
Blizzard and Thunder-Bolt wrestled to a double count-out.

matches.stipulation: 2nd Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Sabre defeated Blitzkrieg with a Flying Cross Body in 21:42.

matches.stipulation: 2nd Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Dr. Doom defeated Crush with a small package in 20:55.

matches.stipulation: 2nd Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: "The Machine" Matt Gavin defeated Silkk the Shocker by countout -- Silkk was a no-show for the match.

matches.stipulation: 2nd Round Match of the WICeW United States Heavyweight Championship Tournament
matches.note: Duke "The Predator" Puzo defeated Jupiter with the Predator's Bite in 28:06. Puzo controlled most of the match, but Jupiter began a comeback around the 23-minute mark until the Shadow arrived at ringside and Jupiter, distracted trading words with him, was caught by the Predator's Bite for the loss.
